decisive_items: numerous round, thin-walled air cysts (2–5 mm) scattered in both lungs
no irregular cyst shapes were noted
response.rationale: Both candidates share the same raw support span, but R1 has a raw contradict span explicitly noting no irregular cyst shapes, which is more consistent with Birt-Hogg-Dube syndrome than with lymphangioleiomyomatosis. The recurrent bilateral pneumothoraces and small round thin-walled cysts favor BHD, while LAM typically presents with more diffuse irregular cysts and often chylous effusions, which are absent here.
